abort.not_ready: Home Assistant has not loaded its voice timer system yet. Try again in a minute.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Satellite Timers is already set up.
abort.unsupported: This Home Assistant version changed how voice timers work internally, so Satellite Timers cannot read them.

bridge_voice_routing.description: The Satellite Timers voice routing did not install, so voice timers are handled by Home Assistant's built-in path. Dashboard timers and timer sensors still work. Restart Home Assistant to try again, and check for an update to Satellite Timers if it keeps happening.
bridge_voice_routing.title: Voice timer routing is not working

undelivered_timer_events.description: A finished timer was acknowledged, but the hub could not confirm the satellite stopped ringing: the stop message could not be delivered. {pending} stop(s) are still waiting. The hub re-sends the stop as soon as the satellite is reachable again — measured on the test rig, that cleared this warning within about a second — and gives up after {window} minutes, the ring window. Reaching the satellite only means it answered, not that the stop arrived: if the satellite is still ringing, dismiss the timer again.
undelivered_timer_events.title: A dismissed timer may still be ringing

init.description: The primary satellite is the one a dashboard timer rings when no satellite is named; leave it unset with a single satellite. A timer that finished while the system was down never rings — it is shown, not announced — and a stopped alarm is never re-rung.
init.title: Satellite Timers
